messages:
sam: Heads-up — PR #16231 is ready from my side but CI has been slow all morning. There's a maintenance window starting in ~2h. Do we want to land now if CI finishes, or hold until after the window? :thinking:

maria: What's failing in CI? flaky tests or infra timeouts?

sam: Mostly macOS matrix timeout + one flaky integration test. Link: https://git.company/repo/pull/16231

alex: I can watch CI and rerun the flaky job if it finishes, but if the maintenance window triggers a deploy freeze we should avoid landing. What are the freeze hours again?

lee: Freeze is 16:00-18:00 UTC for DB migration. If we land before 16:00 we're fine, otherwise we need to wait.

jordan: If we need to wait, we could do a quick canary (small traffic) post-window. I can take responsibility for the canary rollout. :+1:

sam: That works. Right now the longest running job is the macOS matrix step (currently queued). If it gets green in the next 30m we can attempt to merge and run a manual canary before 16:00.

maria: @alex can you keep an eye and ping here when all green?

alex: Yep — I'll monitor and rerun failing job if it's transient. Ping me with :eyes: if you need manual re-run.

deploy-bot: pipeline status for PR #16231 — ubuntu: passed, linux-integration: passed, macos-matrix: queued (runner: mac-pro-7), docs-check: passed.

sam: If macos stays queued >20m we should abort and hold. We don't want to risk rollout during DB migration.

jordan: Agreed. Also FYI, if we land and the canary shows latency increase, fallback is a quick revert + deploy. I'll prepare the rollback playbook just in case.

alex: macos job just started. will update.

(2m later)

alex: macos passed! reran the flaky integration once, looks stable. :tada:

sam: Great — can someone approve the PR? @maria @lee?

maria: Approving now. small comment left but not blocking. :white_check_mark:

lee: Approved. Please coordinate the merge so it goes out at least 30m before freeze.

sam: Merging in ~2 minutes, will monitor canary and post status here.

deploy-bot: merge started for PR #16231 by sam — creating canary deployment (10% traffic).

sam: Canary healthy at +5m, no errors, latency flat. Proceeding to full rollout in 5.

jordan: I'll watch logs and metrics during rollout. ping me if anything odd.

sam: Full rollout complete. All checks green. Thanks everyone for the quick ops. :rocket:

lee: Nice! Saved the freeze window by ~40m.

maria: Nice teamwork. I'll add an entry to the release notes for this one.

sam: Closing thread. If anything crops up I'll reopen.
